name: Four Seasons Rabat at Kasr Al Bahr
positioning: Oceanfront hotel in Rabat, in a restored Kasr Al Bahr palace on the Atlantic coast, opened October 2024
best_for: Travelers who want an Atlantic-coast base in Morocco's capital
Guests interested in Moroccan hammam and spa time

facts.text: The hotel sits on the Atlantic coastline in Rabat's Quartier de l'Océan.
The property was built in the late 1700s as a summer residence for Sultan Moulay Slimane.
The property has 11 buildings, five new and six historic.
The hotel has a traditional Moroccan hammam.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre with ocean views.
The hotel has two outdoor pools.

highlights.text: Verdello serves Italian and Mediterranean dishes.
Flamme is an all-day dining venue with an interactive kitchen specializing in oven-baked cuisine.
Premier Rooms offer a panorama of the Atlantic Ocean.
The hotel has a year-round indoor pool.

considerations.text: The property was a military hospital that closed in 1999 before the hotel opened.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife options in the immediate vicinity.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
